from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's 10-Q quarterly report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Quarter end date in YYYY-MM format")
    shares_outstanding_current_q1: float | None = Field(description="Weighted-average basic shares for current quarter")
    shares_outstanding_prior_q1: float | None = Field(description="Weighted-average basic shares for prior year quarter 1")
    net_cash_from_operating_activities: float | None = Field(description="Net cash provided by (or used in) operating activities, in thousands or millions as reported")
    net_cash_used_financing_activities: float | None = Field(description="Net cash used in (or provided by) financing activities, in thousands or millions as reported")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets as of period end, in thousands or millions as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Unit of financial figures: 'thousands' or 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
